metadata.segment: Ecommerce / DTC — mid-market ($2-5M+ revenue), baby / family products / CPG focus
metadata.persona: Director of Marketing / marketing leader at a DTC consumer brand
metadata.completed_by: sms-brief skill (Layer A market research analyst)

fields.1_buyer: Director or VP of Marketing — the marketing lead — at a mid-market DTC consumer brand in the baby / family / CPG space, roughly $2-5M revenue and up (per strategist's floor; nothing smaller). They own customer acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and Amazon and run a paid-media budget in the ~$60-150K/month range against a 2-3x ROAS target. [source: Master Sheet Tab 3, 'VP of Marketing / Marketing lead at DTC Brand' row — Primary Responsibilities]. They are the decision-maker or primary influencer on agency relationships and marketing spend, typically reporting to the Founder/CEO who holds final sign-off [source: Master Sheet Tab 3, Decision Authority = 'Decision Maker/Influencer'; reports-to inferred from DTC norm, NOT specified in the row — see GAP]. Career background is performance/growth marketing — they came up running paid acquisition, in-house or at a prior DTC brand [source: Master Sheet Tab 3, Current Solution = 'Running ads in-house with 1-2 junior performance marketers']. CONTEXT — relatable proof Big Leap can claim in/near this category: The Honest Company (baby/CPG, GEO+SEO+Content, #1 'newborn baby diapers', 14% ecommerce conversion lift), Milk Snob (DTC baby, Shark Tank), and Spoonful of Comfort (DTC gifting, 2,362% organic revenue) [source: Big Leap Case Studies Scored & Tiered sheet — TIER 4 reference context only, not buyer evidence]. IMPORTANT FRAMING NOTE: Big Leap's Master Sheet account-targeting tab (Tab 2) has NO ecommerce/DTC/baby/CPG row — the only DTC row present ('Supplements / Director to Consumer') is the Scaletopia-supplied template, literally marked '<<<< EXAMPLE', so it is NOT Big Leap's own data and was not used as evidence. All persona evidence below comes from the one genuine DTC persona row in Tab 3, which skews paid-media and supplements-flavored. See the Strategic Tension note at the foot of the brief.

2_pains.text: Agency fatigue — this buyer has already churned through 2-3 agencies that over-promised and under-delivered, and 'firing the current agency' is itself a stated trigger to go shopping. This is the single best-corroborated pain in the file and doubles as the #1 reply-blocker.
2_pains.verification: verified (4 appearances across 3 distinct Tier 2 sources + 1 Tier 3)
sources: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row, Pain Points: 'Tried 3 agencies, none delivered—either terrible creative or can't scale past $10K/day spend'
Master Sheet Tab 3, Current Solution: 'Rotating between agencies every 6-12 months after underwhelming results'
Big leap onboarding form.txt (trigger: 'firing current agency')
ajitkumargupta.com — 'hired SEO agency 6 months, no results' is a widely-shared frustration (vendor blog, directional)

2_pains.text: Paid acquisition is getting more expensive and less efficient — CAC is climbing, Meta is squeezing margin, and profitability is eroding under their feet.
sources: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row, Pain Points: 'Our CAC has gone from $35 to $85+ in 18 months—Meta is bleeding us dry'
admetrics.io / get-ryze.ai — average DTC paid CAC $42-87 vs ~$12-18 organic; paid costs up ~89% since 2019 (vendor blogs, directional)

2_pains.text: Growth has plateaued — they're breaking even on ads but can't crack the next revenue ceiling on paid alone.
2_pains.verification: unverified — single Tier 2 source (needs transcript corroboration)
sources: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row, Pain Points: 'Breaking even on ads, but growth has plateaued at $400K/month—can't crack past it'

2_pains.text: Organic discovery is eroding — AI Overviews and zero-click search are compressing the top-funnel traffic SEO historically delivered, raising the stakes on whoever owns their organic strategy. (Directly relevant to Big Leap's SEO/GEO wedge; thin on direct buyer evidence here.)
2_pains.verification: unverified — single Tier 3 source (directional market context, not this buyer's stated words)
sources: thedigitalbloom.com 2025 Organic Traffic Crisis report — AI Overviews cut CTR 15%->8% (47% reduction); ~60% of Google searches end without a click; median publisher -10% YoY H1 2025

2_pains.text: Ad-account compliance / claims restrictions — accounts get flagged and they can't make the claims they want. NOTE: this is supplements/health-flavored (it comes from the supplements-leaning persona row) and is likely LESS central for a baby/family/CPG brand; flagged for the strategist to discount.

outsider_phrases.quote: vanity metrics that don't influence the business
outsider_phrases.source: Big leap onboarding form.txt — Big Leap's OWN stated anti-pattern: they win by tying to business goals, not impressions/rankings-for-their-own-sake. Avoid leading with rankings/impressions in copy to this buyer.

outsider_phrases.quote: GAP: a list of true outsider 'tells' (phrases that mark the sender as not-a-DTC-operator) normally comes from sales transcripts — none exist yet. Treat agency-jargon ('synergy', 'holistic funnel', 'we'll 10x your organic') as default-avoid until transcripts confirm.

4a_industry_beliefs.belief: Growth = more ad spend / better creative. Paid is the real lever; organic is a 'nice to have' you get to later.
4a_industry_beliefs.why_wrong: Their entire stated remit and every 'care-about' is paid (Meta/ROAS/CAC/creative), yet their own headline pain is that paid has plateaued and CAC has doubled — the paid-only model is exactly what's capping them. The escape is an owned, compounding channel (SEO/GEO/content), which is precisely Big Leap's proof in this category (Honest Company, Spoonful of Comfort).
4a_industry_beliefs.source: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row (responsibilities + care-abouts all paid; pains show the ceiling) — Tier 2 inference

4a_industry_beliefs.belief: Organic / SEO is too slow and is dying anyway — AI Overviews and zero-click killed it, so it's not worth the wait.
4a_industry_beliefs.why_wrong: The traffic shift is real, but it's a bifurcation, not a death — brands that move early on GEO + traditional SEO are capturing the high-intent, compounding, lower-CAC demand that paid can't profitably reach (Honest Company ranks #1 'newborn baby diapers'; organic CAC runs a fraction of paid). The belief is the SETUP for the hook, not a fact to concede.
4a_industry_beliefs.source: Inferred from the paid-only persona posture (Master Sheet Tab 3, Tier 2) + thedigitalbloom 2025 zero-click narrative (Tier 3). FLAGGED: partially inferred — needs transcript corroboration that THIS buyer holds it.

4b_service_objections.objection: Another agency. I've already churned through 2-3 that didn't deliver — why are you any different?
4b_service_objections.dissolving_mechanism: Lead with a SPECIFIC same-category client + SPECIFIC result + SPECIFIC mechanism — not 'we help brands grow.' For baby/CPG, name The Honest Company or Milk Snob so the first line proves category fluency and a real outcome before they can file you under 'generic agency.'
4b_service_objections.source: Master Sheet Tab 3 ('Tried 3 agencies, none delivered'); Big leap onboarding form.txt ('firing current agency' as a trigger) — Tier 2, verified pattern

4b_service_objections.objection: SEO/organic is slow — I won't see anything for 6-12 months, and I need speed.
4b_service_objections.dissolving_mechanism: Compress the perceived timeline with a real, fast proof point: Honest Company's results inside a 6-month engagement, or Spoonful of Comfort's revenue lift in a 6-month window. Pair the organic play with the 'speed to result' they already care about.
4b_service_objections.source: Master Sheet Tab 3 (care-about: 'Speed to result') — Tier 2; ajitkumargupta.com 'no results after 6 months' frustration — Tier 3

4b_service_objections.objection: You won't get our category — you'll run generic SEO and treat a DTC baby/CPG brand like every other client.
4b_service_objections.dissolving_mechanism: Name the baby/family logo and the category-specific keyword win ('#1 for newborn baby diapers'), and reference brand-led-performance (not vanity rankings) so it reads like an operator who knows DTC, not a channel vendor.
4b_service_objections.source: Master Sheet Tab 3 ('terrible creative' = agencies not getting the brand) — Tier 2, single-source; corroboration needs transcripts. FLAGGED unverified.

5_dream_outcome.text: A sustainable CAC and a brand that can scale past the current ceiling — not just a temporarily-good ROAS month.
5_dream_outcome.source: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row, What They Care About Most: 'Sustainable CAC', 'Scalability' (Tier 2 SEED — needs transcript to confirm/replace)

5_dream_outcome.text: A path off the paid treadmill — an acquisition channel that compounds instead of stopping the second the budget stops.
5_dream_outcome.source: Inferred bridge from the plateau + rising-CAC pains (Master Sheet Tab 3) + organic-compounds market context (Tier 3). FLAGGED: partially inferred.

5_dream_outcome.text: Results fast enough to matter this quarter — 'speed to result', not a 12-month SEO promise.
5_dream_outcome.source: Master Sheet Tab 3, DTC Marketing Lead row, What They Care About Most: 'Speed to result' (Tier 2)

6_sophistication.evidence: Speaks in blended CAC, 2-3x ROAS targets, and $/day spend ceilings; has run paid in-house with performance marketers; has been through multiple agency cycles and distinguishes failure modes ('terrible creative' vs 'can't scale past $10K/day'). Per the rubric that's Mid-High — they speak the agency's language back and critique tactics. CAVEAT: this sophistication is on the PAID side; their organic/SEO sophistication is unknown and may be lower (which is the opening).
6_sophistication.source: Master Sheet Tab 3, 'VP of Marketing / Marketing lead at DTC Brand' row (Tier 2)

7_reply_behaviour.gap: GAP — no prior SMS/cold campaign history for Big Leap in this (or any) segment. Onboarding form states: 'Haven't done much outbound/cold before - mostly inbound. Ads have mostly been google search/bottom of funnel' [source: Big leap onboarding form.txt]. No campaign log exists. First send will inform future briefs. Directional only: the verified agency-fatigue pattern suggests specificity (named client + number + mechanism) will out-pull generic 'we help DTC brands grow' openers.
